items.summary: Q: How were you able to get that result today? "Um..I don't know 😅. it was a bizarre race. Obviously a massive pack with the slipstream being so important. I think our pace generally was pretty good, we're obviously lacking a bit on the straights but I think we're making up for it in the corners. It was just a bit odd in terms of overtaking and where you would overtake, like it wasn't normal. Is the only way I could put it. There was a bit of strategy involved with the buttons used and where to use your energy, where to save it and stuff like that so I think we did a pretty good job on that."
